text:
leah - Sales: Quick q from ACME POC — they want to run a hybrid POC (hosted + on-prem inference). They dropped a SIG/CAIQ and a set of DPA redlines. Need clarifications on telemetry (what we collect during private deployment), retention/DSAR flow for the POC, and a short-term pricing estimate for dedicated nodes. They want answers by EOD Wed. Can security/legal/eng chime in?

omar - Security: Thanks. Can you attach the SIG/CAIQ link? We need to confirm control mappings for on-prem telemetry and network egress. Short answer: Hosted = telemetry to Redwood, Private = customer-controlled but our agent sends a minimal heartbeat. I'll list exact fields.

leah - Sales: Attached partial SIG here: https://acme.example/sig.pdf (DM me for full). Their two hot questions: "Do you log prompt/response tokens during private deployment?" and "How do you handle DSARs and deletion for data created during the POC?"

chen - Legal: For the DPA redlines: our standard DPA covers POC retention of 30 days unless otherwise scoped. We can accept a 14-day retention for a time-boxed POC with a one-page addendum. For DSARs during POC — typical flow is customer handles subject requests on their instance; Redwood will assist with exports or a verified deletion run on request. I can draft the addendum.

natalie - Eng Platform: On the private agent side: telemetry payload contains only `{heartbeat_ts, instance_id, gpu_metrics, anonymized_usage_counts_optional}`. No prompt/response payloads leave the VPC by default. If they opt into `report_usage`, we stream hashed token counts (not raw text). Example config snippet they can apply: ```yaml
redwood.agent.telemetry:
  report_usage: false  # send only heartbeat and metrics
  retention_days: 14
```

sam - Solutions: For hosted traffic during hybrid: default retention is 30d, but we can set to 7d for a short POC. Pricing: short-term dedicated nodes are quoted hourly for POC; I'll DM numbers and an estimate of expected token cost. Heads-up — committed Dedicated pricing needs a 1-month minimum.

omar - Security: For the SIG/CAIQ we should map controls like this: private deployment -> customer-managed data (controls met by customer), hosted -> Redwood-managed controls. Also confirm encryption: private can bind to customer KMS/HSM; we support TLS in transit + AES-256 at rest by default. I'll prepare a control-ID mapping table for the SIG answers.

leah - Sales: Action items: @chen draft 14d POC DPA addendum; @natalie confirm telemetry fields and paste the config snippet we can return to customer; @sam price DM + short cost table; @omar SIG control map by EOD. I'll consolidate and reply to the customer once we have the snippets + addendum.

chen - Legal: :thumbsup: I'll have a one-page addendum draft in ~2h and upload here.

natalie - Eng Platform: :eyes: Quick note on DSAR delete workflow for private deployments — recommended flow: `1) customer submits DSAR -> 2) admin runs: redwood-cli export --subject <id> --format json -> 3) verify -> 4) redwood-cli scrub --subject <id> --force`. We can provide the exact script and RBAC guidance.

sam - Solutions: :lock: DMing preliminary hourly pricing now. Also flagging that if they require SCCs for cross-border data, legal needs to confirm the commercial language.

leah - Sales: Perfect, thanks everyone. If timelines slip, tell me and I’ll update ACME. Will post consolidated reply once I have the addendum + config + SIG mappings.
